limits: The first retained-cache profile is build then vet then race compilation/linking. Application test executables are replaced with /usr/bin/true; no application tests or databases run.
All cold ordinary trials start with an empty task-owned cache. Ordinary timings use five alternating trials per side. OS file caches, thermal state and unrelated host load are uncontrolled.
Race cold timing is one observation per side. It does not establish a general race-compilation speedup.
Package archive locations do not identify authorship; consumer objects contain framework instantiations.
Object text, string, relocation and debug sizes are descriptive categories, not independently removable costs.
Native Runner wall time includes process monitoring, directory sampling and 0.2-second polling. Short warm-vet differences are inconclusive.
Runtime probes cover repeated model validation, table request preparation, DTO decoding, typed endpoint handling and validation. Declaration registration costs and database throughput are unmeasured.
Object sizes identify stored categories, not costs that can be deleted independently of the Go type and link graph.
Independent GPT source and evidence reviews were used. No different model family was available.
